Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Mosaic Throw Pillow - 20 x 20 Inch, Blue
Colors: Blue
Bring a bit of retro flair to your bedroom with this mid-century inspired mosaic design. Geometric patterns in blue, black and ivory will add a sophisticated modern touch to your room. For a different look, flip it over to the solid black side. Pillow cover features hidden bottom zipper 20"L x 20"W, Pillow cover dimensions are measured from seam to seam when cover is laid flat. Removable plush fiber-filled insert included Spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
